notes.title: Dev Update June 2025
notes.content: [p]Hey Folks,[/p][p]It's been a rollercoaster of a year so far with the official release of Frisson DT in early access and my moving house and finishing this years Uni studies.[/p][p]Now that I'm all settled in and have some more free time until next years studies begin, it's back to getting Frisson DT to where I want it to be. In no particular order here is what is coming in the next few updates:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Bug fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Artifact collection for rewards and display cases[/p][/*][*][p]Upgradable player HQ[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorials (Yes I have been listening!)[/p][/*][*][p]Game rebalance. I am aware that the game is currently very difficult, it was partly intended but I certainly didn't intend for Frisson DT to be a "Souls-like" game.[/p][/*][*][p]New Tiers of equipment[/p][/*][*][p]In-game feedback forms. (hopefully). I'm aware that some players don't want to mess about with accessing the steam discussion boards or composing emails, so I'm planning to add in-game feedback so that you can quickly send bug reports or general feedback from inside the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]There are also a few things that I am re-thinking based on feedback, such as the research system and card battle extensions. It's been said that using research to unlock new items may distract too much from the main game and that simply unlocking new gear based on achievements or player level might be more streamlined. I've also only had limited feedback on whether the card battling system is currently enjoyable at all, so please let me know in the comments or the discussion boards if you want to see more of the card system added or if you prefer to just hunt ghosts.[/p][p]As far as the rebalancing goes, I want to make sure that Frisson DT is still a challenge, more-so than other games in this genre, but I don't want to make it so hard that it's boring. This might mean the difficulty varies over the next few updates as I try to tune it.[/p][p]Finally a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] from me for buying the game in early access. I'm struggling to get any traction with live-streamers since I'm a lone-dev and can't afford to pay for the big streamers[/p]

notes.title: BOOM!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

I just wanted to post a huge thank you to the 20 legends who have already taken on the responsibility of becoming a paranormal live-streamer / card collector.

I'm currently working on the next update. This update will feature the artifact crate. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413379/6e096a22b104d4355da4d5d6427055877b8d0a96.png[/img]

What? just a crate? seriously?

Let me explain.

You might have noticed that currently the equipment upgrade store includes listings for some equipment but not all equipment. This is because some items require to be unlocked using research (which I haven't implemented yet but it's coming soon) rather than money. 

Research will use Experience points which are earned by completing investigations, certain challenges and gathering artifacts. These artifacts will be found hidden in each map (in different locations) and can be picked up and deposited in the crate. Additionally any object which has been moved by an entity can also be deposited in the crate for additional research points (excluding items moved during a paranormal event)

This update will be coming in the next few weeks. Following that I am to start working on player HQ upgrades and the next tier of equipment.

Wanna help?

The best way anyone can help right now is to help us get Frisson DT out there and seen / played by as many people as possible by sharing, streaming etc but I will also be posting polls soon on the discussion board to see what people want to see in upcoming content, so engage with the discussion boards too. 

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: Frisson DT early access release
notes.content:
The wait is almost over. Frisson DT launches on Steam this week. It's been an incredible journey bringing this game to life so far and I can't wait for you do dive in and experience the horror (and the fun) as well as adding even more content in the coming months.

This isn't just another Paranormal investigation game release, this is an evolving game and your experience will help to shape it. While I've worked very hard to make it as polished as possible, I know that there are still some rough edges, and that's where you come in!

🎮 Here’s how you can make launch even better:
✔ Play, have fun, and explore! There’s a ton to discover.
🐛 Report any bugs or weirdness in the Discussions tab – your feedback will help me improve the game.
🔥 Join the conversation! Share your thoughts, strategies, and favourite moments with the community.

I appreciate every single one of you for being part of this adventure. If you love what I’ve built, tell your friends—every bit of support helps!

💬 Are you ready for launch? Drop a comment below and let me know what you're most excited about!

#Steam #IndieGame #LaunchDay #GameDev

notes.title: Influencers Assemble!
notes.content:
Hey Ghost Hunters!

We’re looking for passionate content creators to help showcase Frisson DT before its release! If you're a YouTuber, Twitch streamer, or game journalist, we’d love to offer you a review/demo key—but only if you meet our criteria.

✅ [b]Who We’re Looking For:[/b]
You have at least 500+ YouTube subscribers or 300+ Twitch followers.
Your videos/streams average at least 300 views or 5+ concurrent viewers.
You actively create gaming content (your last post should be within the last 60 days).
You regularly cover Horror Games or indie games in general.
You’re genuinely interested in playing, reviewing, or streaming Frisson DT.

🚨 [b]IMPORTANT:[/b]
We have limited keys, so we can only approve creators who meet these requirements. If you're just looking for a free game with no intent to cover it, please don’t apply! Requests that don’t meet the criteria will be ignored.

🎤 [b]How to Apply:[/b]
If you meet the requirements, please fill out this short form:
📌 [url=https://forms.gle/AK4eqWku9FTwHJgC7]Link[/url]

OR email us at [info@frissondt.com] with:

Your YouTube/Twitch channel link
Your subscriber/follower count
Your average video views/concurrent viewers
A few words on why you're excited to cover Frisson DT

💡 [b]What We’d Love in Return:[/b]

A gameplay video, stream, or review featuring the game.
A fair review on Steam if you enjoy the game.
Thank you to everyone who applies! We’re excited to see your content and hope to work with some amazing creators. Let’s make Frisson DT something special together!

The Frisson DT Dev Team

notes.title: 31st Jan 2025 Update
notes.content:
Welcome Paranormal Live-streamers and Card Collectors!

As release day draws ever closer, we've been busy beta testing our diffusers off whilst getting the main elements of the game as close to "feature complete" as possible.

The Card battling system is ready to go and should provide you with hours of fun, it's likely that the multiplayer elements of this will be completed soon. 

We've added three maps for you to get started with and there will be plenty more coming, all with their own spooky lore and secrets for you to find. 

As it currently stands the plan will be to release the first early-access version within the next 4 weeks. Of course this is subject to change depending on how Beta testing goes.

Stay tuned and wishlist Frission DT today!

notes.title: It's almost time!
notes.content:
The green light is here, release is on the horizon! We're putting the final touches on the early access version, making sure it’s just right before you, our fearless Paranormal Investigator Live Streamers, dive in to start building your careers in the supernatural.

Right now, you’ll have access to three thrilling, immersive maps and an incredible roster of 27 distinct paranormal entities to uncover. And to ensure you’re ready to hit the ground running, we’re working on a short tutorial to guide you through the essentials, perfect for newcomers and veterans alike.

Don’t miss out, Wishlist Frisson DT today and stay in the loop on all the latest updates!
